question: Identify the top 10 and bottom 10 interest categories based on their highest composition values across all months. For each category, display the time(MM-YYYY), interest name, and the composition value
sql:
WITH max_per_interest AS (
    SELECT 
        imma.interest_name,
        im.interest_id,
        MAX(im.composition) as max_composition,
        im.month_year
    FROM interest_metrics im
    JOIN interest_map imma ON im.interest_id = imma.id
    WHERE im.composition IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY imma.interest_name, im.interest_id, im.month_year
),
max_per_category AS (
    SELECT 
        interest_name,
        MAX(max_composition) as highest_composition,
        month_year
    FROM max_per_interest
    GROUP BY interest_name, month_year
),
ranked_categories AS (
    SELECT 
        interest_name,
        highest_composition,
        month_year as time,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY highest_composition DESC) as rank_desc,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY highest_composition ASC) as rank_asc
    FROM max_per_category
),
top_10 AS (
    SELECT interest_name, highest_composition, time
    FROM ranked_categories
    WHERE rank_desc <= 10
    ORDER BY highest_composition DESC
),
bottom_10 AS (
    SELECT interest_name, highest_composition, time
    FROM ranked_categories
    WHERE rank_asc <= 10
    ORDER BY highest_composition ASC
)
SELECT * FROM top_10
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM bottom_10
